w: After his morning puja, Swamishri worshipped the canvas murtis to be established at a moral center in Jolva.

At 11.00 a.m., Swamishri blessed the assembly, "We have listened to the glory of the Swaminarayan mantra from the former speakers... Out of all strengths, the power of God is supreme. Some exercise the power to rule, some have money power and some have the power of scriptural knowledge; everyone talks of their powers but above all is God’s power. Everything is under His powers. Where did people get their powers and strengths? From God! So God is all-powerful. It is because of Him the world runs... If God has so much power then His name too has power. It is all a matter of having faith. We have faith in our businesses and thus invest millions of rupees because we know that we will get a thousand-fold back. Likewise, one requires faith in God."

At 6.55 p.m. Swamishri left Bharuch and reached Navsari at 7.37 p.m. In addressing the assembly of devotees Swamishri said, "After the establishment of this mandir in Navsari there has been a tremendous progress in the local Satsang... On Sundays people spend their day partying or travelling around but Yogiji Maharaj has said that our Sundays should be spent in such a way that we experience peace of mind..."
This morning, Swamishri departed from Mumbai to Gandhinagar to bless and welcome Mr. Bill Clinton in his visit to Akshardham.

With the prevailing communal violence in Gujarat, some leading citizens had requested Swamishri to make an appeal for peace. A video recording of Swamishri's message was arranged and it was telecasted in the news program throughout Gujarat.

Thirty-six tribal people from the Dang district sang traditional bhajans during Swamishri's morning walk. A sadhu sang a bhajan in the Dangi language and explained the activities of BAPS and glory of Swamishri. Thereafter a couple of tribals narrated their transformation through their association with Satsang. Finally Swamishri blessed the tribals and initiated them into Satsang.

Swamishri attended a special volunteer's assembly in the morning. After Swamishri's arrival at 10.30 a.m. Thereafter they enacted a drama 'Commando' showing the discipline and sacrifice of BAPS volunteers. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

ds.t: Who will fill the potholes in our lives?
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was returning. Students of the Vidyamandir were exercising with dumbbells. Amid the pleasant sound of the dumbbells knocking together, Vinay, a sadhak driving the golf cart, said to Swamishri, "Bapa! Before you came here, there were potholes and bumps on this road. We levelled them, but they became just the same again. In the same way, who will fill the potholes and bumps in our lives?"
"Yogiji Maharaj, whom you have attained, will fill them," Swamishri reassured him.
"But we have not seen Yogiji Maharaj."
"Here he is!" Swamishri began his sentence like this, and then said, "The murti of Yogiji Maharaj can be seen everywhere, can't it? Keep looking at it."
"What should we understand about the one sitting beside us?"

"He is sitting here in person." After saying this decisive sentence, Swamishri said, "Yogiji Maharaj is seated in the heart. He is in everyone's heart. Pray to him, and then no potholes or bumps will come anywhere in life."

After yesterday's inauguration ceremony of the water show, the dignitaries present had showered a flood of opinions. These were told to Pramukh Swami Maharaj during his morning meal. Ishwarcharan Swami and all the sadhus who run this show were sitting there, and one opinion after another came pouring out. There was joy on everyone's face. Brahmavihari Swami and Aksharvatsal Swami described the opinions of the dignitaries who had come yesterday.

During the conversation Brahmavihari Swami said to Swamishri, "First of all, thank you, because two days ago when testing was going on, the wind was blowing and the steps of the amphitheatre were getting wet, and everyone was wondering, 'What will happen at the inauguration programme?' That is why we came rushing to you and requested, 'Please bless us that the wind does not blow.' When everyone was worried, you alone were steady. You only said, 'Shriji Maharaj protects our honour every time. God does everything so that we do not become proud and stay down to earth.' Even then we were not convinced. The day after we spoke there was still wind. And you had said, 'Not even a leaf will move, God will be gracious,' but yesterday at 4:00 in the evening there was still wind. So our worry kept growing. Today you took care of even the smallest concern of the invited dignitaries. Even at 5:00 in the evening you phoned and asked about the arrangements for all these dignitaries, you asked about the smallest detail, but in that ten or fifteen minute conversation you did not ask anything about the wind. How much faith you have in Shriji Maharaj! So we all believe it is only your grace. If you had not held back the wind, what would have happened? In fact you are God himself. If you were not God, this would not have been possible."
Swamishri immediately said, "Where did that come from? How are we God?"
"If you were not, who could show such divine power?"
Swamishri said, "God speaks, Shastriji Maharaj and Jogi Bapa speak. They are the ones who speak. They are also the doers."
"They speak, but through you, don't they?"

Swamishri said nothing. So Brahmavihari Swami said, "When everyone was worried, there was tremendous calm on your face. You had said that Maharaj has never let our honour be lost so far. Not a leaf will move. All of this was seen to come true yesterday. Not a leaf was moving. A video has been taken too."
Of course, all this praise did not touch Swamishri in the least. He remained composed in his true self, he remained detached.

After that, there was a flood of glowing opinions from the many dignitaries who had enjoyed the water show yesterday. Everyone felt proud in their hearts. Their joy knew no bounds. One after another, everyone shared the opinions they had heard. Pramukh Swami Maharaj also listened to these opinions, but without being carried away by this flood of praise, right after his meal Swamishri became busy in a meeting about the arrangements of a mandir in a small town. Swamishri himself had called the devotees of Jambusar. After the meeting with them was over, Swamishri called Nikhilesh Swami and said, "Those devotees from Jambusar are going to stay here, so make all the arrangements to show them the show, and also arrange their lunch."
This was a darshan of Swamishri's equality and affection towards all.

From 4:00 in the afternoon, Julian, business manager of ECA2, sat waiting for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan. He had already had Swamishri's darshan yesterday, but today, before leaving, he felt inspired and expressed his wish not to leave without darshan. Also, seeing the thread tied on Yves Pépin's wrist, he too had wished to have a thread tied. He said to Swamishri, "I have come to thank you. I am leaving today. I was here for only two days, but today I go back with peace in my heart. I travel all over the world and do big projects, but I have never felt such divine joy anywhere. I will remember you every day and remember the work I have done with the Sanstha. I want to give up cigarettes, and my prayer is that whoever works with me, and whoever they may be, may all be happy."
Swamishri was pleased to see his feelings and gave him his blessings.

ds.t: A thread always on the wrist
w: Anilbhai Naik, managing director and CEO, the head of Larsen and Toubro (L&T), had come to receive Pramukh Swami Maharaj's blessings. In the last month he had received three awards. He had also received the Padma Bhushan award from the central government. Drawn by Swamishri's divinity and saintliness, he has not merely remained an admirer of satsang but has actually become a satsangi. He always keeps on his wrist the nadachhadi (sacred thread) tied by Swamishri. Even now, showing the thread, he said to Swamishri, "Look at this, I always keep it with me. I take it off only once a year and immediately have another one tied."
Today too Swamishri tied a new thread for him.
He also said, "Whoever comes into my office, there is only one photo on my wall, and that is of Pramukh Swami Maharaj."

Today, after completing his daily routine, Mahant Swami Maharaj sat in the lift to go to the mandir. Hoping for Swamishri's blessings, some blank space and a pen had been placed in the lift. As he came down in the lift, Swamishri wrote: "Seeing everyone as faultless is itself our service." Then he signed below: "Sa. Ke." (Sadhu Keshavjivandas).
Just as Yogiji Maharaj had given the maxim "Seeing others as faultless is itself devotion," Swamishri today gave a concise definition in the same spirit.

When Mahant Swami Maharaj landed at Mwanza airport on a flight from Dar es Salaam, the Regional Commissioner, Shri John Mongella, had come to welcome him. He is in very close contact with our devotees here and is himself devout at heart. In just a short conversation with Swamishri, he was completely drawn to him. He wished that Swamishri would ride in his car, but since Swamishri's arrangements had already been made, that was not possible. Mongellaji offered another option: "Then let me ride with Swamishri in his car." His request was granted.

Swamishri went to Lake Victoria to immerse the asthi (sacred ashes of the departed). After the immersion, as Swamishri sat in the car to leave for the airport, Shri Mongellaji again wished to ride with him. Once more he was given a seat in Swamishri's car. Swamishri returned to Mwanza airport. Mongellaji came to see Swamishri off all the way to the plane. Like a sincere satsangi (devotee), he would somehow make his way forward to offer his arm as support, and so take the benefit of Swamishri's company. So here Swamishri too held his arm for support.
Mongellaji said: "In Africa there is a belief that when a great person comes, it rains. And today when you came, it rained too. So you are a holy person."

Finally, expressing his feelings, he said: "It is sad that you are going. Next time I will spend a full day with you." (In Gujarati: "It is sad that you are going. Next time you come here, I will spend the whole day with you.")
As they neared the plane, the sadhus jokingly asked Mongellaji: "Would you like to come with us to Entebbe?"
Mongellaji was truly ready and said: "Yes." He was genuinely happy to go with Swamishri.
To create so deep an impression in a single meeting is the power of the Satpurush alone.
Earlier, in the car, he had said: "A spiritual atmosphere is created around Swamishri. Very few people in the world have such radiance. So I naturally came to love him."
He too came to know that a Satpurush like Swamishri is "not found among lakhs, not even one among crores, but only one among billions."

When Mahant Swami Maharaj sat for his dinner, the conversation turned to how Yogibapa (Yogiji Maharaj), while passing over Lake Victoria, had made a divine wish that all the creatures in it attain liberation. Swamishri spoke wonderful words: "The liberation of all the fish, their sons and daughters, is still going on." Everyone burst out laughing.
Who besides the Satpurush (the God-realized guru) can know whose liberation is going on, and where!
